purpose: Separate zero-fit outcome-source coverage variant for the already-exposed Week 6 archive; preserve the original sparse-source comparison unchanged

frozen_predictions.protocol_deviation: Carry forward selected cold-context inference deviation; no retrospective prior substitution

sources.sleeper: Preserve per-target actual/participation from frozen rows; missing fields remain unknown, never infer zeros
sources.nflverse: Existing cached 2026 Week 6 statistics through common grading_sources.load_cached_grading_context/cached_nflverse_outcome
sources.identity: Exact frozen archive Sleeper/GSIS and independent ESPN final game/team/kickoff bindings; ambiguous identities stay unsupported
sources.vintage: Current reconstructed source vintage; source original publication and historical availability unverified; no Week 8+ outcomes

resolution.sleeper_missing_nflverse_supported: Qualified explicit NFLverse values may expand this separate variant; explicit dense zeros are supported outcomes
resolution.nflverse_missing_sleeper_supported: Retain supported original value with source gap recorded
resolution.numeric_disagreement: Quarantine both; no source winner or fabricated correction order
resolution.participation_disagreement: Known played versus DNP conflict quarantines the target outcome
resolution.counts: Finite nonnegative integer outcomes only; missing values are not zeros
resolution.unsupported: Exact PPR unsupported and archived anytime probabilities unbound; no invented scoring

evaluation.matching: Same resolved actual and archived identity for every compared prediction; pairwise plus five-method common support
evaluation.uncertainty: Existing paired week evaluator and descriptive game bootstrap, 500 replicates; one exposed week cannot qualify production
evaluation.selection: Frozen methods only; no fit, tuning, prediction change or method selection

preservation: Original predictions, row files, report bytes, metrics and fit count remain unchanged. New local variant rows and public derived aggregate report are separately named and hashed.
promotion: disabled; original protocol deviation and one-week/exposed-data limitations remain
